data.name: [MFTK: Survivors] Mortemforge: TekaRenzen's Konquerax: Survivors
data.detailed_description:
MFTK: Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelite, 95% auto-shooter, bullet-heaven.

Set in a stylized, bizarre and dark, technofantasy universe inspired by 80's Sword & Sorcery and European Graphic novelists (Druillet, Moebius, etc), Heavy Metal, GrimDark and Bisley art, 90's Anime and Cartoons, 70's psychedelia, DieselGoth, Chaos, big-boobed women, and both the Roman and Holy Roman Empires.

Gameplay summary as of July, 1st:

Inside map-runs: battle hordes of enemies while you level up, upgrade your Arsenal from random options and Chest rewards, pillage resources. There's 5 maps.

Outside map-runs: you can switch your body/vessel, select your weapon, and decide what map you'll run next.

The DRY gameplay summary:

You go in map and do stuff, when you come back home you prepare for the next map. Repeat.

Runs consist of an infinite mode.

Features, as of July, 1st:

  • Experience the joy of turning into a walking blender!

  • Select your character's looks and weapons from the options you collect.

  • Do runs / battle hordes on hand-crafted maps. You get a list of random available maps out of 5 possible ones. Map list refreshes by re-opening the map selector.

  • Gather exp to level up, kill monsters for chests, money and blood.

  • Acquire Weapons, Artifacts, and Upgrades during runs. Gather resources for your operational costs.

  • Blood and Gore-chunk enemy explosions. Smooth gameplay (weak CPUs may go as low as 50 fps when screen is loaded to the max, working on it).

  • Infinite mode, let's see how long you survive!

What are the features I'm prioritizing right now?

I gotta do one of those RoadMap graphics.

Right now, the top priorities are adding a couple more weapons and pickup types, getting the upgrade shop ready and finally fixing the bugs with the destructibles. Then: finishing the profile system, save system and unlocks.

After that:
Pillaging actual resources (right now is just money), capture control points during runs, making resource costs actually matter during map selection, and more enemy movement types.

Current Early Access limitations:

  • I haven't added any censorship, aka Streamer mode, in the settings. That being said, 100% of the nudity is in the north-west / top-left corner of the Frozen Steppes map, so pretty easy to avoid if you need to.

data.short_description: Conquer and pillage planets as a one-man army in this brutal action roguelite set in a bizarre and dark Technofantasy universe. Battle hordes, plunder your enemies, forge devastating arsenals, and carve your path through endless intergalactic god-wars under the watchful eye of a mysterious goddess.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 5500 or Core i5-11400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 580
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Stylized and cartoony depictions of:

- Violence, blood, gore effects, and dismemberment.

- Some characters wearing revealing outfits, some partial nudity.

- Fictional drug-like items and references to fantasy substances.

Some unlockable content is obtained through a gacha-style mechanic using only in-game resources.
